name: Prayer to Elune
summary: The Prayer to Elune is etched on a golden tablet and lies among the Twilight’s Hammer’s belongings. It carries a plea meant for Astarii Starseeker at the Temple of the Moon.

sections.title: A Golden Tablet
sections.body: Among the Twilight’s Hammer’s belongings in Searing Gorge lies a golden tablet bearing a prayer to Elune. Astarii Starseeker at Darnassus’s Temple of the Moon asks that it be brought to her, so the prayer can reach its goddess.

faq.q: What is the Prayer to Elune?
faq.answer: The Prayer to Elune is a prayer etched onto a golden tablet.
The golden tablet is among the Twilight’s Hammer’s belongings in Searing Gorge.
Astarii Starseeker at the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus asks for the prayer.
Astarii wants the prayer returned so it can be heard by Elune.

angles.text: As a night elf, you know Elune as your people’s goddess; this tablet carries a prayer meant to reach her.
